content.text:
The replay fixed the connect problem completely, and cut the duplicate picture card from every run to about a third. It did not fix the original finding's core problem: after adding a printer, the model still often doesn't offer to connect, and when it offers buttons they're usually a bare "Yes | No". Those don't depend on chat history, so they need the system prompt to spell out the wording, or the app to supply it.

I measured each problem 30 times with the current system prompt, once with the old text-only history and once with the new replay:

| Problem from my earlier assessment | Text-only history (before) | Replay (now) |
|---|---|---|
| **Connecting:** reached the access-code card | 22/30 | **30/30** |
| **Choosing "Prusa MK4S" from three:** looked it up again, a duplicate picture card | 30/30 | **11/30** |
| Choosing from three: added the right printer | 30/30 | 30/30 |
| Choosing from three: reply offers to connect | 9/30 | 8/30 |
| Choosing from three: reply has buttons | 7/30, mostly "Yes \| No" | 6/30, mostly "Yes \| No" |
| **Typing "bambu lab a1 mini":** reply offers to connect | 17/30 | 23/30 |
| Typing a model: reply has buttons | 9/30, mostly "Yes \| No" | 14/30, 10 of them "Yes \| No" |

**How to read the typed-model rows.** That case is a single turn, so there's no earlier history, and the requests under both headings were identical. The gap (17 against 23 offering to connect) is therefore pure run-to-run noise. Gaps of about six runs out of 30 mean nothing; the connect and duplicate-card changes are far larger than that.

**Fixed by the replay**
- **Made-up printer ids when connecting.** Gone. Tool results now carry the real id into the next turn.
- **Small prompt edits breaking connecting.** Gone. The receipt line that dropped connecting to 4 of 20 now gets 40 of 40.

**Much better, not gone**
- **The duplicate picture card** after choosing from a list (11 of 30). The model can now see its earlier lookup, but a third of the time it looks the printer up again anyway.

**Not fixed; not a history problem**
- **The offer to connect after adding** appears 27% to 77% of the time, depending on the path.
- **Buttons after an add** appear in only about a third of replies, and most say just "Yes | No".

The current system prompt only says "offer it once" and "two to four short answers", so the model improvises each time. This is where your proposed flow comes in: exact words and exact buttons for this moment, possibly with the offer coming from the `printer_add` result. The same test can measure that.

content.text:
Done. After a printer is added, the chat now shows the "Printer added" card, and the model's reply ends with the same offer every time: "Want to connect it so you can send prints straight to it?" with the buttons **Connect it** and **Not now**. The live run with the real app and model passed every check, and the screenshots above are from it. Nothing is committed yet.

**What changed**
- **The system prompt:** one line in [printerInstructions.ts](src/slic3r/GUI/JusPrin/AgentUI/src/printerInstructions.ts) spells out the exact question and buttons for after a successful add. A unit test checks the wording.
- **The prompt test:** two new add-printer cases, one naming a model and one choosing from three. They use real session data recorded from the app ([add_session.json](tests/printer_prompt/add_session.json)): the full printer list and the tools' real answers.
- **Carried over from before:** the "Printer added" card, its tests, the receipt checks in the live test, and the live test's option to save page states for screenshots.

**Results**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Prompt test, 30 runs per case | connect 30/30, name a model 30/30, choose from three 30/30 |
| Offer and buttons after an add | exact wording every time, versus 27–77% offer rate before, mostly with "Yes \| No" |
| Chat page tests | 190 of 190 |
| Live test, real app and model | passed every check |

**Two things you may notice in the screenshots**
- **The duplicate picture card after choosing "Prusa MK4S" is still there.** This branch predates the tool-call replay, so the app here still sends text-only history. With the replay, the prompt test shows the duplicate in only 4 of 30 runs.
- **The offer can appear twice.** When the person says "yes, add it" again, the model repeats the offer after saying the printer is already added. Only the newest message shows the buttons.

**Next steps, both yours to approve:**
1. **Rebase `claude/printer-receipt-card` onto the current `jusprin-newui`**, so this branch's app code includes the replay the test now assumes. That rewrites the one test commit on this unpublished branch.
2. **Commit** the card, the system prompt line and the tests.

Should I go ahead with both?
go ahead with both. Do live testing afterwards and take screenshots so that I can see what the final user experience look like.
